name: Core & Infrastructure
description: The App service-locator/bootstrap, project-wide enums, and shared helpers (JSON parsing, RPS judging, frame monitoring) that every other layer depends on.

name: Managers
description: App-driven singleton and per-scene managers (network, player, lobby, in-game, data, asset, sound, input, title) plus their ManagerBase/SceneManagerBase/UIManagerBase base classes that orchestrate the game's subsystems.

name: Networking
description: Photon Fusion lobby and session objects: the [Networked] PlayerNetworkObject, session/player state models, result wrappers, and lobby-code utilities for real-time multiplayer.

name: Gameplay
description: Core RPS gameplay domain: player/enemy hands, fingers, hand-sprite data, game-mode flags, and the HP-bar visual effect that drive match logic.

name: UI & Presentation
description: uGUI panels and reusable slot/modal widgets for the title, lobby, and in-game HUD, all built on the PanelBase lifecycle hub that self-registers with the UI managers.

name: Editor Tooling
description: Unity Editor utility windows for generating HandSpriteData ScriptableObjects from JSON and for fast scene launching during development.

name: Game Data & Project Config
description: Game-balance JSON tables (boon, define, deviation, enemy, round) consumed by DataManager, Unity package manifests, and the CLAUDE.md project guideline document.
